A screen reader announces it as just "link" with no indication that it goes to search—the purpose is completely hidden. **Who it affects** Screen reader users cannot tell where this link leads. They hear "link" and have to tab through to reach it, only to discover its purpose by following it or checking the URL bar. **The fix** ```html ``` The `aria-label="Search"` gives the link an accessible name that screen readers will announce. Since the icon itself is marked `aria-hidden`, the label is the only content assistive technology sees, which is exactly what you want here.", "tool_calls": 0}
